t: What Fastener Engineering Database Is All About
title: What Fastener Engineering Database Is All About
description: Fasteners are preloaded springs: torque creates clamp force; the joint — not the bolt — carries shear by friction. Grades mark strength (8.8, 10.9 metric; Grade 5/8 inch); galling seizes stainless; hydrogen embrittlement cracks high-strength plating. Torque specs assume lubrication — dry vs oiled changes clamp 30%+. The joint diagram (bolt vs member stiffness) is the whole science. This database is the complete fastener record: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
